task_metadata.research_topic: sample reweighting for long-tailed image classification
task_metadata.research_question: Design a novel sample reweighting strategy for class-imbalanced image classification that improves test accuracy on long-tail distributed datasets across different architectures and imbalance ratios.
notes: Task edits are restricted to pure class-count-to-weight logic in pytorch-vision/custom_weighting.py.
Benchmarks are CIFAR-10-LT and CIFAR-100-LT with ResNet-32 and hidden VGG-16-BN evaluation.

tests.label: resnet32-cifar10lt
tests.notes: ResNet architecture on CIFAR-10-LT; CIFAR-LT benchmark convention is widely standardized in the LDAM paper.

tests.label: resnet32-cifar100lt
tests.notes: ResNet architecture on CIFAR-100-LT; benchmark linkage follows the LDAM long-tail evaluation setup.

tests.label: vgg16bn-cifar100lt
tests.notes: Hidden evaluation swaps in VGG-16-BN while keeping the same CIFAR-100-LT benchmark family.

baselines.name: inverse_freq
baselines.notes: Inverse-frequency weighting is a standard heuristic rather than a single canonical method paper; linked approximately to the imbalanced-learning survey that covers class-frequency reweighting.

baselines.name: effective_number
baselines.notes: Exact match to the class-balanced weighting formula based on effective number of samples.

baselines.name: balanced_softmax
baselines.notes: Task baseline matches the Balanced Softmax loss introduced in the Balanced Meta-Softmax paper.
